88:1: Has the news of the covering come to you?
88:2: Faces that day, those in humility
88:5: Is watered from a boiling spring.
88:6: For them there is no food other than dry thorns.
88:7: Neither fattens nor benefits against hunger.
88:8: On that day, faces are blessed.
88:10: They are in a high paradise.
88:11: There they do not hear an idle word.
88:12: There is a flowing spring there.
88:15: And there are cushions lined up.
88:17: Do they not look at the camels, how they were created?
88:18: And at the sky, how it was raised
88:19: And at the mountains, how they were erected
88:20: And at the earth, how it is spread?
88:21: So give reminder, surely you are only a reminder.
88:22: You are not an overseer over them
88:23: Except whoever turns away and disbelieves
88:24: Allah punishes him with the greatest punishment.
88:25: Surely their return is to Us.
88:26: Then surely their reckoning is to Us.
